ad.note: The ad and the public artifact are the lure. A visit to claude.ai is not itself the signal.

redirect.note: The artifact redirect is user-generated content. Pair it with the download host.

sideload.note: Unsigned libcef.dll and tempdir.dll load beside signed hosts. The signed host hashes are benign.
